artifacts.title: Free \(\Sigma\)-Algebra and Evaluation

components.name: Parameter
components.tex:
Shared bridge machinery. Parameter: a signature \(\Sigma\). This card is
instantiated by connective evaluation, term evaluation, parsing, and later by
initial-algebra presentations such as \(\mathbb N\).

components.name: Structure
components.tex:
\[
  \Sigma\text{ is a set of operation symbols},
  \qquad
  \operatorname{ar}:\Sigma\to\mathbb N.
\]
A \(\Sigma\)-algebra is a carrier \(\lvert\mathcal A\rvert\) with operations
\[
  f^{\mathcal A}:\lvert\mathcal A\rvert^{\operatorname{ar}(f)}
  \to \lvert\mathcal A\rvert
  \qquad(f\in\Sigma).
\]
Seeds land in the carrier; homomorphisms are maps of algebras.

components.name: Structure
components.tex:
\[
  T_{\Sigma}(X),
  \qquad
  f^{T}(t_1,\ldots,t_n):=f(t_1,\ldots,t_n),
  \qquad
  \eta:X\to T_{\Sigma}(X).
\]

components.name: Syntax--Semantics Bridge
components.tex:
\[
  \operatorname{Hom}(h,\mathcal A,\mathcal B)
  \quad:\Longleftrightarrow\quad
  h(f^{\mathcal A}(\bar a))
  =
  f^{\mathcal B}(h(a_1),\ldots,h(a_n))
\]
for every \(f\in\Sigma\) and \(\bar a\in\lvert\mathcal A\rvert^n\).

components.name: Axioms and Laws
components.tex:
\textbf{No junk.}
\[
  t\in T_{\Sigma}(X)
  \Longrightarrow
  t\in X\ \vee\
  \exists f\in\Sigma\,\exists\bar t\,\bigl(t=f(\bar t)\bigr).
\]
\textbf{No confusion.}
\[
  x\neq f(\bar t),
  \qquad
  f(\bar s)=g(\bar t)\Longrightarrow f=g\wedge \bar s=\bar t.
\]

components.name: Boundary
components.tex:
The machine fixes one seed. Connective and term evaluation are exact
instances. FOL quantifiers range over the assignment-indexed family
\((\sigma_s)_s\):
\[
  \mathcal A,s\models\exists x\,\varphi
  \Longleftrightarrow
  \exists a\in A,\;\mathcal A,s[x\mapsto a]\models\varphi.
\]
That is the downstream cylindric/polyadic layer. The absolutely free
\(T_{\Sigma}(X)\) is also distinct from the Lindenbaum--Tarski quotient by
\(\vdash\)-equivalence.

artifacts.title: Definitional Extension (Propositional Logic)

components.name: Admissibility
components.tex:
A connective \(\star\) of arity \(n\) is admissible by a defining equivalence:
\[
  \star(\bar\varphi)\leftrightarrow\theta(\bar\varphi),
  \qquad
  \widehat v(\star(\bar\varphi))
  =
  F_{\star}(\widehat v(\varphi_1),\ldots,\widehat v(\varphi_n)).
\]
There is no \(\exists!\) obligation because formulas already evaluate to truth
values.

components.name: Instances
components.tex:

  \top:\equiv(p_0\to p_0),
  \qquad
  \bot:\equiv\neg\top,
\]
\[
  \varphi\oplus\psi
  :\equiv
  ((\varphi\vee\psi)\wedge\neg(\varphi\wedge\psi)).
\]

components.name: Axioms and Laws
components.tex:
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=1.6em,itemsep=2pt]
  \item \textbf{1. Extensionality}
  \[
  \forall x\,\forall y\,
  \bigl[\forall z\,(z\in x\leftrightarrow z\in y)\to x=y\bigr].
  \]

  \item \textbf{2. Empty Set}
  \[
  \exists x\,\forall y\,\neg(y\in x).
  \]

  \item \textbf{3. Pairing}
  \[
  \forall x\,\forall y\,\exists z\,\forall w\,
  \bigl(w\in z\leftrightarrow (w=x\vee w=y)\bigr).
  \]

  \item \textbf{4. Union}
  \[
  \forall x\,\exists y\,\forall z\,
  \bigl[z\in y\leftrightarrow \exists w\,(w\in x\wedge z\in w)\bigr].
  \]

  \item \textbf{5. Power Set}
  \[
  \forall x\,\exists y\,\forall z\,
  \bigl[z\in y\leftrightarrow \forall w\,(w\in z\to w\in x)\bigr].
  \]

  \item \textbf{6. Infinity}
  \[
  \begin{aligned}
  \exists x\,\Big[&
    \exists y\bigl(y\in x\wedge \forall w\,\neg(w\in y)\bigr)\\
    &{}\wedge
    \forall y\bigl(y\in x\to
      \exists z\,(z\in x\wedge
        \forall w\,(w\in z\leftrightarrow (w\in y\vee w=y)))\bigr)
  \Big].
  \end{aligned}
  \]

  \item \textbf{7. Separation Schema}
  For each formula \(\varphi(z,\bar w)\) in which \(y\) is not free:
  \[
  \forall \bar w\,\forall x\,\exists y\,\forall z\,
  \bigl[z\in y\leftrightarrow (z\in x\wedge \varphi(z,\bar w))\bigr].
  \]

  \item \textbf{8. Replacement Schema}
  For each formula \(\varphi(x,y,\bar w)\) in which \(B\) is not free:
  \[
  \begin{aligned}
  \forall \bar w\,\forall A\,\Big[&
    \forall x\bigl(x\in A\to \exists!y\,\varphi(x,y,\bar w)\bigr)\\
    &{}\to
    \exists B\,\forall y\bigl(y\in B\leftrightarrow
      \exists x\,(x\in A\wedge \varphi(x,y,\bar w))\bigr)
  \Big].
  \end{aligned}
  \]

  \item \textbf{9. Foundation}
  \[
  \forall x\,\Bigl[
    \exists y\,(y\in x)\to
    \exists y\bigl(y\in x\wedge
      \neg\exists z\,(z\in x\wedge z\in y)\bigr)
  \Bigr].
  \]
\end{enumerate}

components.name: Layer Delta
components.tex:
\textbf{AC}
\[
\begin{aligned}
\forall x\,\Big[&
  \bigl(\forall y\,(y\in x\to \exists z\,z\in y)\\
  &{}\wedge
  \forall y\,\forall y'\,
    ((y\in x\wedge y'\in x\wedge y\neq y')\to
      \neg\exists z\,(z\in y\wedge z\in y'))\bigr)\\
  &{}\to
  \exists c\,\forall y\,(y\in x\to
    \exists!z\,(z\in y\wedge z\in c))
\Big].
\end{aligned}
\]
